details:
Why is the "gift VRC+" button at the top in bright yellow and bigger than more important buttons like the report button? Why is the "give me your money" button more important than the report button? Also, there's no longer an avatar button on people's profiles anymore. You used to be able to open a person's profile and open their avatar without having to actually turn on and load the user's profile. "Ah, this fella looks like he's in a crasher avi; let me check the info on his avi to find out. "Well, if you want to know now, you have to take the chance of crashing yourself. The UI on the VRC website works because the website takes up your entire screen. While the UI in game has a little menu to fill. Profile effects are just another thing users have to load, and another thing you have to spend money on. The old menu was much more compact and actually appealing to look at. Also bring back the yellow friend tact instead of a big bubble around the person's name. 

Enough ranting. I made a little doodle for what some of these things could look like.

Using compact icons below the name look much better than the stupidly big icons we have now. You get all the info you need on a user without it taking up a quarter of your screen.
title: The new menu really sucks. It makes it harder for moderation inside of instances.
